article.title: Knowledge requisite for valid ratification.
article.content:
198Knowledge requisite for valid ratification.

Section 198  ·  Chapter X  ·  Ratification  ·  page 45 of the Act
No valid ratification can be made by a person whose knowledge of the facts of the case is materially defective.
